abstract: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) comprises a group of human neoplastic diseases that derive from fetal trophoblastic tissues. They are proliferative as well as degenerative disorders of placental elements and include complete hydatidiform mole (CHM) or partial hydatidiform mole (PHM) (90%), invasive mole (IM) (5-8%), which could also be metastatic, villous, or villous choriocarcinoma (CC) (1-2%), and placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) (1-2%). We present three cases of GTN, two mimicking tuberculosis radiologically, and all three are associated with pulmonary embolism.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）は、胎児栄養膜組織に由来するヒト新生物疾患の群を含む。これらは胎盤要素の増殖性および退化性障害であり、完全水疱状奇胎（CHM）または部分水疱状奇胎（PHM）（90%）、侵襲的奇胎（IM）（5-8%）、転移性または絨毛癌（CC）（1-2%）、および胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）（1-2%）を含む。結核をまねる2つと、すべて肺塞栓症に関連する3つのGTNの症例を呈示する。
